name: [UPD🚨] Arrest Brainrot
desc:
🤑 Collect criminal brainrots and earn Coins!
🧠 Defend your prison from other players!
👣 Sneak into enemy bases and steal their Brainrots!

👋 Welcome to Arrest Brainrot 👋

[How to Play]
• Buy criminal brainrots that appear through the tunnel
• Get them to your prison to generate Coins
• Visit other players to see their brainrots
• Steal epic brainrots and dominate the leaderboard!
